PASS

Phase 10 meets the methodological and artifact requirements.

- Confirmed Phase 9 has an independent PASS checkpoint and validated commit.
- Chronological split is correct: 2,660 training, 570 validation, and 570 locked-test rows.
- Loader reads only rows `[0, 3230)`; locked rows `[3230, 3800)` are excluded.
- Validation windows are causal and use only observations preceding each target.
- `RobustScaler` is fitted solely on training rows; saved center and scale exactly match an independent fit.
- No feature selection, CV, Optuna tuning, or locked-test evaluation occurs.
- Early stopping uses validation only; training has `shuffle=False`.
- Seed 42 and environment/configuration details are preserved.
- All 570 prediction dates, actual targets, and naïve lag-1 values align with the source data.
- Independently recomputed MAE, MSE, RMSE, and R² agree with saved metrics within CSV precision.
- PatchTST MAE is `2123.664370`, versus `215.432519` for naïve lag-1; artifacts correctly make no superiority claim.
- All 13 recorded artifact hashes match. Model, scaler, predictions, metrics, 19-epoch history, diagnostics, configuration, and logs exist.
- The Keras archive is structurally valid; all saved predictions and history values are finite.
- Git shows only expected untracked Phase 10 source, tests, and artifacts; no tracked modifications or deletions. `git diff --check` and AST parsing pass.
- Live pytest/model loading was unavailable because the read-only validator environment has no writable temporary directory. Preserved evidence reports 3 focused and 196 full-suite tests passing, and direct read-only verification found no conflicting evidence.
